intents.rationale: Add DagSchedulingState str Enum (active, draining, paused) next to DagRunState.
DagModel only has is_paused; add is_draining column, check constraint, property, setter, migration 0134 (down_revision f8c2a1d94e03), update db.py revision head map and migrations-ref.rst.
Scheduler's dag-needing-run query, asset manager queuing (direct, alias, name/uri) and partitioned-asset run creation currently only filter on is_paused; add draining exclusion.
TI scheduling filters on is_paused only, so draining Dags already pass; keep that, ensure the new exclusions do not leak into TI queuing or run examination, and cover with tests.
New _finalize_draining_dags step registered via timers.call_regular_interval(5.0, ...) in the scheduler loop.
Auto-pause update sets only is_paused=True; also set is_draining=False.
Public datamodels and PATCH routes handle only is_paused; add scheduling_state, exactly-one validation, update_mask handling, bulk PATCH setting both flags, regenerate openapi yaml.
Add scheduling_state filter param, has_unfinished_runs on UI Dag responses (independent of dag_runs_limit), and make dashboard active count exclude draining.
set_is_paused CLI helper filters on is_paused != target and sets only is_paused; change to set scheduling state and treat draining as needing change; add scheduling_state to dags details.
Document draining in Dag concepts and FAQ; add airflow-core newsfragment (user-facing feature).
Extend existing suites for the model, scheduler, asset manager, public/UI routes, CLI and state enum.

criteria.text: DagSchedulingState has exactly members/values active, draining, paused (test_state.py).

DagModel.scheduling_state derives active/draining/paused from flags; set_scheduling_state sets both flags consistently; is_draining defaults to false; the DB rejects is_paused and is_draining both true.
Migration 0134 (3.4.0) adds is_draining column with index and check constraint plus index on backfill (dag_id, completed_at); utils/db.py head map and migrations-ref.rst updated.
A draining Dag is not returned by dags_needing_dagruns for scheduled runs, and no run is created for its pending partitioned-asset events.
AssetManager records the asset event but does not queue a draining Dag scheduled directly, via alias, or by name/URI; active Dags still queue.
Task instances of queued/running runs of a draining Dag are still scheduled and queued, and its unfinished runs are still examined; manual triggers still create runs.
_finalize_draining_dags moves a draining Dag with no queued/running run and no backfill without Dag runs to paused, clears draining and logs drain_completed with owner scheduler.
_finalize_draining_dags leaves a Dag draining when it has a queued or running run, or a backfill row with no Dag runs; processes in dag_id order with limit and row locks.
The scheduler loop registers _finalize_draining_dags with a 5 second interval.
Auto-pause after consecutive failed runs sets is_paused true and is_draining false for a draining Dag.
DAGResponse/DAGDetailsResponse expose scheduling_state defaulting to active; GET reflects draining.
PATCH /dags/{dag_id} and PATCH /dags accept exactly one non-null of is_paused/scheduling_state (explicit null for the other accepted); both, neither, or a null-only field yield 422.

update_mask naming is_paused or scheduling_state works when matching the body; a mask naming the other field is 422; response reflects new state; bulk PATCH sets both flags; is_paused true/false clears draining.
/ui/dags scheduling_state filter returns only matching Dags; paused=false includes draining; paused filter otherwise unchanged.
Every Dag in /ui/dags has has_unfinished_runs true iff a queued/running run exists, regardless of dag_runs_limit.
airflow dags pause sets paused and clears draining; unpause sets active and clears draining; a draining Dag counts as changed by both; dags details output includes scheduling_state.
dags.rst and faq.rst describe draining; newsfragment airflow-core/newsfragments/22006.feature.rst added; 'Dag' casing used in prose.

tasks.summary: Single PR: add DagSchedulingState enum, then DagModel column/property/setter plus migration 0134 (db.py head map, migrations-ref); then scheduler changes (dags_needing_dagruns, partitioned-asset runs, _finalize_draining_dags + 5s timer), asset manager, dagrun auto-pause; then public and UI API (datamodels, PATCH validation, filter, has_unfinished_runs, dashboard, openapi yamls), CLI; then docs, newsfragment; extend/adjust existing tests alongside each layer. Do not touch the React UI.
